## About
Nani Auto Repair is a full service auto shop at 940 Livingston Ave in North Brunswick Township. We handle repair, maintenance and service, from full tune ups to engine and transmission work.
When you come in, you're often dealing with Nani, the owner, himself. Customers who leave reviews talk about fair prices, straight answers and good work.
We're rated 4.8 from 74 Google reviews. Call the shop or book an appointment online.

## Services
- Diagnose and repair: Something feels off or the car won't start? We find the cause and fix it.
- Replacing calipers: One reviewer had a leak issue fixed by replacing the caliper, done quickly and professionally.
- Engine oil leakage and gasket repair: Engine oil leakage fixed carefully, including gasket sealant work.
- Full tune ups: Regular maintenance to keep your car running the way it should.
